from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseInfo(BaseModel):
    """Features of a single legal document required for classification."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The exact title of the document as provided")
    case_nature: str | None = Field(description="The legal nature of the case (e.g., 'Administrative', 'Civil', 'Criminal')")
    proceeding_stage: str | None = Field(description="The stage of proceedings (e.g., 'Trial', 'Enforcement', 'Retrial')")
    administrative_subject: str | None = Field(description="The administrative entity involved, if any (e.g., 'Civil Affairs Bureau', 'Township Government')")
    dispute_focus: str | None = Field(description="The core dispute subject (e.g., 'Ownership', 'Administrative Legality', 'Personal Rights', 'Execution')")
    is_enforcement: bool | None = Field(description="Whether the case involves enforcement proceedings")
    is_criminal: bool | None = Field(description="Whether the case is a criminal case")
    is_administrative: bool | None = Field(description="Whether the case is an administrative case")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated facts extracted from the provided documents."""
    cases: list[CaseInfo]
